description: Android planting activity detail screen. Depends on FEAT-001 (backend endpoint must exist for runtime, but not for compile). Add ActivityDetailDto and friends to Api.kt, add repository method, create PlantingDetailViewModel.kt and PlantingDetailScreen.kt, wire navigation in AppRoot.kt so tapping an activity row opens the detail screen instead of navigating to MONITOR.
steps: Step 1 — Api.kt: Before the 'interface BahariMrvApi' declaration, add four data classes: MonitoringRecordViewDto(aliveCount:Int=0, plantedCount:Int=0, averageHeightMetres:String="", species:String="", observations:String?=null, attestationStatement:String?=null, evidence:List<EvidenceViewDto>=emptyList()), EvidenceViewDto(id:String, kind:String, sha256:String, mediaType:String), ProvViewDto(status:String, network:String?=null, explorerUrl:String?=null, objectId:String?=null), ActivityDetailDto(id:String, projectId:String, plotId:String, activityType:String, status:String, methodologyVersion:String?=null, periodStart:String?=null, periodEnd:String?=null, record:MonitoringRecordViewDto?=null, provenance:ProvViewDto?=null). Add to BahariMrvApi interface: '@GET("api/v1/activities/{id}/detail") suspend fun activityDetail(@Path("id") activityId: String): ActivityDetailDto'.
Step 2 — ProjectRepository.kt: Add 'suspend fun activityDetail(activityId: String) = api.activityDetail(activityId)' after the retryIdentity method.

Step 3 — New file PlantingDetailViewModel.kt at android/app/src/main/java/ke/co/baharilink/baharimrv/ui/planting/PlantingDetailViewModel.kt. Package: ke.co.baharilink.baharimrv.ui.planting. Imports: ViewModel, viewModelScope, HiltViewModel, Inject, ActivityDetailDto, ProjectRepository, LoadState, readableMessage, MutableStateFlow, asStateFlow, update, launch. Data class PlantingDetailUiState(val detail: LoadState<ActivityDetailDto>? = null). @HiltViewModel class PlantingDetailViewModel with load(activityId: String) method that updates state to Loading, calls repository.activityDetail, updates to Success or Error using e.readableMessage(). Import 'ke.co.baharilink.baharimrv.ui.components.readableMessage' explicitly.

Step 4 — New file PlantingDetailScreen.kt at android/app/src/main/java/ke/co/baharilink/baharimrv/ui/planting/PlantingDetailScreen.kt. Package: ke.co.baharilink.baharimrv.ui.planting. Top-level composable PlantingDetailScreen(activityId: String, onBack: () -> Unit, viewModel: PlantingDetailViewModel = hiltViewModel()). Uses LaunchedEffect(activityId) to call viewModel.load. Local 'var showFullScreenPhoto by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }'. Scaffold with TopAppBar (title 'Activity detail', ArrowBack nav icon calling onBack). when(state.detail) branches per plan step 7 description. Private ActivityDetailContent composable with 5 sections: (1) ContextHeader, (2) monitoring record BahariCard with KeyValue rows or EmptyState, (3) evidence thumbnail BahariCard with BahariDashedBox + sha256 first 8 chars or Text('No evidence attached'), (4) NavyLedgerCard on-chain section with KeyValue rows + BahariButton GREEN 'View on IOTA ↗' launching Intent(ACTION_VIEW) via LocalContext.current when explorerUrl non-null, (5) BahariCard attestation section. Private statusColor(status: String): Color helper. Private FullScreenPhotoOverlay using Dialog(DialogProperties(usePlatformDefaultWidth=false)) with fillMaxSize black background.

Step 5 — AppRoot.kt: In 'private object Routes' add: 'const val PLANTING_DETAIL = "planting/detail/{activityId}"' and 'fun plantingDetail(activityId: String) = "planting/detail/${Uri.encode(activityId)}"'. Add import 'import ke.co.baharilink.baharimrv.ui.planting.PlantingDetailScreen'. In NavHost after the PLANTING_CREATE composable, add: composable(route = Routes.PLANTING_DETAIL, arguments = listOf(navArgument("activityId") { type = NavType.StringType })) { backStackEntry -> PlantingDetailScreen(activityId = backStackEntry.arguments?.getString("activityId").orEmpty(), onBack = { navController.popBackStack() }) }. In the existing PLANTING composable block, change 'onActivityClick = { activityId -> navController.navigate(Routes.MONITOR) }' to 'onActivityClick = { activityId -> navController.navigate(Routes.plantingDetail(activityId)) }'.
acceptance_criteria: PlantingDetailViewModel.kt and PlantingDetailScreen.kt exist in the ui/planting/ package
AppRoot.kt Routes object contains PLANTING_DETAIL constant and plantingDetail() function
AppRoot.kt PLANTING composable block's onActivityClick calls Routes.plantingDetail(activityId) instead of Routes.MONITOR
Api.kt contains ActivityDetailDto, MonitoringRecordViewDto, EvidenceViewDto, ProvViewDto data classes and activityDetail endpoint in BahariMrvApi
findings: CROSS-FEAT INTEGRATION VERIFICATION (iteration 1): Android ./gradlew :app:assembleDebug is BUILD SUCCESSFUL (covers compileDebugKotlin, KSP and Hilt aggregation, dexing and packaging). JSON contract seam verified consistent with backend: ActivityDetailDto, MonitoringRecordViewDto, EvidenceViewDto and ProvViewDto field names match the backend activityDetailView, monitoringRecordView, evidenceView and provView JSON tags exactly in camelCase. The BahariMrvApi.activityDetail endpoint path matches the backend route. ProjectRepository.activityDetail delegates to api.activityDetail; PlantingDetailViewModel.load toggles LoadState and surfaces readableMessage on failure; AppRoot registers the PLANTING_DETAIL route and PlantingListScreen onActivityClick now navigates to Routes.plantingDetail(activityId) instead of Routes.MONITOR. The screen handles all null and empty states gracefully: a null record shows No monitoring data, blank or null observations show No observations, empty evidence shows No evidence attached, a null provenance shows Not yet anchored on-chain, a non-null explorerUrl renders a green BahariButton labeled View on IOTA that launches ACTION_VIEW, and a blank attestation shows No attestation recorded. SEAM GAP versus user intent: the photo is not actually rendered. The evidence card and FullScreenPhotoOverlay show an Icons.Default.Image placeholder plus the sha256 prefix, because the backend detail response carries no media-fetch URL and no GET endpoint streams monitoring-record evidence bytes. Closing this requires a behavior and scope change (backend media endpoint plus Android image rendering, with the stack locked and no Coil or Glide) and was raised as a product-decision warning.
